description: This file defines a React functional component 'TestCaseView' that renders detailed information about a test case, including its location, results, annotations, and navigation links. It also includes subcomponents for rendering annotations and retry labels. The file imports several internal and external modules to facilitate rendering and functionality, and contains no executable logic outside of component definitions.
